meta.title: Interrogation mode (Grill)
meta.description: Adds a switch to the composer tool row in every Web conversation, and a /grill on|off|status|toggle command usable in every environment (terminal, ACP/SDK, IM, headless defaults via config). While on, the agent analyzes each request for ambiguity, missing information and contradictions, asks focused questions with concrete repair options, and only plans or executes after every blocking question is resolved. A spawned subagent inherits an active parent; a delegated child reports unresolved questions in its final result; where no human can answer (NO_PROVIDER), the agent writes the questions and acts on its recommendation for reversible work.
